method: Primary PDFs downloaded for research and rendered; actual pages directly inspected, not inferred from abstracts. Reference PDFs/previews stay in build/ and are not redistributed in the manuscript package.

references.title: CLIPort
references.observed: Grouped seen/unseen score bars; aligned language-conditioned Input/Pick/Place images.
references.adopted: Make each comparison answer a stated question and connect qualitative layouts to the command.
references.correction: Earlier review incorrectly called Figure 3 curves; the actual figure uses grouped bars.

references.title: StructFormer
references.observed: Language/spatial structure correspondence and aligned arrangement examples across methods.
references.adopted: Use the saved arrangement to explain spatial structure and constraint satisfaction. No unsupported component ablations are suggested.

references.title: DINOv2
references.observed: Controlled comparisons use consistent visual encodings across tasks and conditions.
references.adopted: One release color/marker vocabulary and explicit empirical contrasts; no ornamental chart complexity.

references.title: Segment Anything
references.observed: Comparative deltas and confidence intervals are tied to defined evaluation units; qualitative examples use marked closeups.
references.adopted: Expose meaningful paired uncertainty; use linked context/detail to explain exact geometry rather than repeat numerical headlines.

references.title: Transporter Networks
references.observed: Render-to-representation explanation and repeated comparisons expose the spatial prediction mechanism.
references.adopted: Explain the distinction between visible mesh footprints and the geometry actually scored.

references.title: Knolling Bot: Teaching Robots the Human Notion of Tidiness
references.observed: Aligned before/state/execution/after views connect the task and preferences to behavior.
references.adopted: Preserve matched source/predicted views and relate the layout to instruction clauses. No execution panel is fabricated for this project.

scope: Borrowed analytical and composition principles only. No external figure artwork, experimental values, or evaluation breadth copied.
